# Environment map licences

No environment map files are shipped here. Reflections come from `GreyEnvironment`
(`src/scene/materials/GreyEnvironment.tsx`), a small cube map rendered at load from four white Lightformer
shapes. Original work, no third-party HDR. Download size: 0 bytes.

## v2 rooms (added 2026-11-11)
Rooms use their own light and shader-driven skies (`SkyDome`); no environment map file is added. Download size: 0 bytes.
